definitions.grouping: cohort (fallback phase/train) x condition (fallback memory_mode) x written_blocks
definitions.training_written_blocks: query: block; write: block+1; explicit diagnostic written_blocks takes precedence
definitions.distribution_weighting: finite event count, not equal weight per block; no averaged block quantiles
definitions.scalar_weighting: one observation per stream/window write block; exact linear-interpolated median and p95
definitions.row_count_scope: touched/new/total_written_rows are per-block state snapshots, not global distinct-row totals
definitions.query_weighting: sum hit counts / sum valid nonzero-address denominators; token-any uses eligible target tokens
definitions.nonfinite: source nonfinite_count retained; null patch norms counted as nonfinite; null moments invalidate merged mean/std
definitions.histogram: fixed source bins; left-closed/right-open except the last bin includes its upper edge

definitions.grouping: cohort (fallback phase/train) x condition (fallback memory_mode) x written_blocks
definitions.training_written_blocks: query: block; write: block+1; explicit diagnostic written_blocks takes precedence
definitions.distribution_weighting: finite event count, not equal weight per block; no averaged block quantiles
definitions.scalar_weighting: one observation per stream/window write block; exact linear-interpolated median and p95
definitions.row_count_scope: touched/new/total_written_rows are per-block state snapshots, not global distinct-row totals
definitions.query_weighting: sum hit counts / sum valid nonzero-address denominators; token-any uses eligible target tokens
definitions.nonfinite: source nonfinite_count retained; null patch norms counted as nonfinite; null moments invalidate merged mean/std
definitions.histogram: fixed source bins; left-closed/right-open except the last bin includes its upper edge
